proved.derivative_at_zero_coprimality: gcd(R_M,F'_M(0))=1 by reduction modulo each root prime
proved.short_gap_vandermonde: the product of all gap labels at most 2D is coprime to R_M and has logarithm o(M) when D is asymptotic to log M
proved.multiplicative_energy: for every n-element set of distinct primes, ordered E_x=2n^2-n, independently of gaps
proved.graph_energy: universal handshake, Cauchy, and modular degree bounds do not upper-bound the positive-degree vertex radical below the admission coefficient
proved.ambient_threshold_saturation: for the full candidate prime set and D~c log M, liminf log(C_all)/M is at least (2c-1)/(12c)
proved.c_1_threshold: the full ambient cluster mass is at least M/12+o(M), exactly the Item395 coefficient that a strict saving must beat
proved.closed_method_class: generic discriminant/derivative/Vandermonde identities, ordinary multiplicative or graph energy, fixed-rank selector data, and sieve or large-sieve estimates valid for every candidate-prime subset
